description: Recorded offences located in the OL15 outward postcode district, excluding cancelled offences and fraud, with crime created dates between 1 April 2024 and 31 March 2026. These are historical statistics for the whole OL15 district, not crimes within a mile of any individual postcode.
warnings: This covers the entire OL15 postal district, not the entered address or one-mile radius.
Dates refer to when offences were created in police systems and not necessarily when incidents occurred.
Fraud and cancelled crime records are excluded. Figures may be revised.
No crime list, offence location or neighbourhood claim may be inferred from a district-level total.

OL15.label: OL15 (Littleborough postal district)
